record.context_brief: Serre functor of Enriques Kuznetsov component
record.original_question: Let X be an Enriques surface and let Db(X) = <Ku(X, L), L> be the semiorthogonal decomposition defined by a collection L of exceptional line bundles. Does the Serre functor S_{Ku(X,L)} admit an explicit and computable description beyond the abstract description coming from the general theory of admissible subcategories?

evidence.quote: Thus, if X is an Enriques surface and L is a collection of exceptional line bundles as in Proposition 2.7, then we get a semiorthogonal decomposition Db (X) = hKu(X, L), Li. The admissible subcategory Ku(X, L) := L^perp is referred to as the Kuznetsov component of X.
Question 2.9. (i) Does the Serre functor SKu(X,L) have an explicit and computable description (other than the abstract one in Example 1.2)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a complex Enriques surface and let $D^b(X)$ denote its bounded derived category of coherent sheaves. Suppose $\mathcal{L} = (L_1, \dots, L_n)$ is an exceptional collection of line bundles on $X$ (i.e., each $L_i$ satisfies $\mathrm{Ext}^\bullet(L_i, L_i) = \mathbb{C}$ in degree $0$ and $\mathrm{Ext}^\bullet(L_j, L_i) = 0$ for $j > i$) inducing a semiorthogonal decomposition
$$D^b(X) = \langle \mathrm{Ku}(X, \mathcal{L}),\ L_1, \dots, L_n \rangle,$$
where the Kuznetsov component is defined as
$$\mathrm{Ku}(X, \mathcal{L}) := \langle L_1, \dots, L_n \rangle^\perp = \{ E \in D^b(X) \mid \mathrm{Hom}^\bullet(L_i, E) = 0 \text{ for all } i \}.$$
Since $\mathrm{Ku}(X, \mathcal{L})$ is an admissible subcategory of $D^b(X)$, it admits a Serre functor $S_{\mathrm{Ku}(X, \mathcal{L})}$, which abstractly is given by the composition of the inclusion, the Serre functor of $D^b(X)$ (i.e., $-\otimes \omega_X[2]$), and the left adjoint to the inclusion.

Provide an explicit and computable description of the Serre functor $S_{\mathrm{Ku}(X, \mathcal{L})}$ beyond this abstract formula coming from the general theory of admissible subcategories.
artifact.status_search_result: Search results indicate that the Kuznetsov component of an Enriques surface fits in the framework of "Enriques categories" whose Serre functor is, abstractly, of the form (involution)∘[2]. However, no source found provides an explicit closed-form description of the Serre functor on $\mathrm{Ku}(X, \mathcal{L})$ for general exceptional collections $\mathcal{L}$ of line bundles, beyond the abstract general construction. The status of an explicit computable formula appears unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Moduli spaces of stable objects in Enriques categories
status_evidence.snippet: Kuznetsov components ... have Serre functor of the form τ ◦[2] where τ is the generator of a nontrivial Z/2-action.
status_evidence.claim: The Serre functor on Enriques-type categories is abstractly described as a Z/2-involution composed with shift by 2, but no explicit description specific to Ku(X,L) is given.

status_evidence.title: On the Fano dimension of an Enriques surface
status_evidence.snippet: Kuznetsov component Ku(X, L) of an Enriques surface defined via exceptional collections of line bundles.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to study Ku(X,L) without providing an explicit computable Serre functor formula.
